## Featured projects
1. MERKI — https://somosmerki.app — Cross-platform supermarket cart calculator for Venezuela (React Native Expo, React, Go/Gin, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker).
2. Business Manager — https://business-manager.edoutput.dev — Microservices business platform with gRPC and polyglot persistence (Next.js, Go, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
3. GPS Medical Assistance — https://gps-medical-assistance.edoutput.dev — Accident detection with facial recognition and Twilio SMS alerts (Angular, .NET 6, MongoDB, PostgreSQL).
4. Viaja Venezuela — https://tourism-agency.edoutput.dev — Tourism agency platform with Clean Architecture/DDD backend (Angular, .NET 7, PostgreSQL).

- Data: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite
- Cloud/DevOps: Azure, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps

## About this site
- Built with Vite 8, React 19, TypeScript 6, GSAP 3.15, Sass CSS Modules, react-i18next.
- Self-hosted on a local machine behind a Cloudflare Tunnel at https://edoutput.dev.
- Supports English (US) and Spanish (LATAM), dark and light themes.
